source_title: India becomes second team after Pakistan to play 300 T20Is - Sportstar
source_excerpt: India becomes second team after Pakistan to play 300 T20Is left India will play its 300th T20I international against New Zealand in the 2nd match at the Hagley Oval. AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/t69vpi/article71619303.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/AP10_22_2026_000205A.jpg JOHN DAVIDSON Shreyas Iyer of India bats during the T20 cricket international between New Zealand and India in Christchurch, New Zealand, Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026. AP/PTI(AP10_22_2026_000205A) Pakistan has played 304 T20Is so far. After India, New Zealand has played the third most matches in the format — 269. CHENNAI India became only the second team after Pakistan to play 300 or more T20 internationals during its 2nd match against New Zealand at Hagley Oval in Christchurch on Saturday. Pakistan has played 304 T20Is so far. After India, New Zealand has played the third most matches in the format — 269. India has won 199 out of its 299 matches so far and has lost 83. It has tied seven and 10 ended without result. Pakistan, however, has only won 176, lost 116 and tied 4. There have eight no result games for it.
